Experience with SIL/HIL testing, test automation and debugging of distributed embedded systems. Strong ability to interpret system requirements, identify relevant signals/interfaces and translate them into effective test scenarios. Ability to work independently, lead technical discussions and interface directly with the customer and multidisciplinary engineering teams. Domain expertise in Supplier Intelligence, Carbon Accounting, Reporting, Traceability and Product compliance. Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, Coupa or ServiceNow, plus industry-specific platforms relevant to your vertical. Exposure to Agentic AI in enterprise SaaS. Prior experience scaling SE teams or building enablement programs. Italian, Spanish or French language skills. Join us for this and more...
